title: Could Cristiano Ronaldo jump high enough to dodge a moving train?
caption: Could Cristiano Ronaldo jump high enough to dodge a moving train? Physics says no. Deutsche Bahn says maybe. 🚄⚽ Don't try this. #could #ronaldo #cr7 #siuuu #physics #deutschebahn #whatif #fyp

scenes.text: Could Cristiano Ronaldo jump high enough to dodge a moving train? {{ev}}We looked at the evidence. {{sci}}Scientifically. ||0.2|| {{long}}From the platform.

On the platform: {{name}}Cristiano Ronaldo. {{h}}{1.87|One point eight seven} metres of Portuguese forward. {{hdr}}In {2019|twenty nineteen}, he headed a ball at a height of {2.56|two point five six} metres. {{nba}}A coach compared him to an NBA player. ||0.3|| {{siu}}He lands every jump with the same word. {{word}}Siuuu.

On the tracks: {{name}}a German high speed train. {{h}}{3.89|Three point eight nine} metres tall. {{len}}About two hundred metres long. {{v}}Top speed in service: three hundred kilometres per hour. ||0.3|| {{late}}Arrival time: theoretical.

Problem one. {{t}}The height. {{need}}To clear the roof, his feet must pass three point nine metres. {{has}}His famous header lifted his feet about seventy centimetres off the ground. {{short}}He is roughly three metres short. ||0.3|| {{slow}}The train does not slow down for legends.

Problem two. {{t}}Hang time. {{pass}}At three hundred kilometres per hour, the whole train needs two point four seconds to pass. {{air}}Ronaldo stays in the air for about three quarters of a second. {{need}}To stay up long enough, he would have to jump seven metres high. ||0.3|| {{wall}}That is the height of the Great Wall of China.

Problem three. {{t}}The timetable. {{db}}In {2025|twenty twenty five}, only sixty percent of German long distance trains arrived on time. {{wait}}So Ronaldo waits. ||0.3|| {{again}}And waits. {{board}}Then he gives up and simply takes the train.

The verdict. {{q}}Could Cristiano Ronaldo jump high enough to dodge a moving train? ||0.5|| {{no}}No. ||0.4|| {{but}}But in Germany, the train might not be moving. {{p1}}Chance he clears the roof: zero percent. {{p2}}Chance he celebrates anyway: ||0.25|| {{p3}}one hundred. ||0.3|| {{safe}}Please do not try this. At home, or at a station.
Could you imagine another scenario that we should do next? {{c}}Write it in the comments.
